snippet.title: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Liminal City: Axiom of Maria is a 3D Metroidvania action-adventure game that blends acrobatic traversal, puzzle-solving, exploration, storytelling, swordplay, and meticulously designed boss encounters. In a world where humanity has nearly vanished due to population collapse, reality and the unconscious are reversed for AI—Beyond, the virtual realm where the deceased are backed up, serves as their reality, while the physical world becomes their unconscious. To AI, humans have become like fleeting monsters in our dreams—beings that wander through AI's unconscious.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3397260/Liminal_City_Axiom_of_Maria__Chapter_One/

Developer: Studio Ganzheit
X: https://x.com/StudioGanzheit
